items.whyStay: Six bedrooms on three floors in Laguna Park 2, a gated villa estate in Laguna Phuket, with a free estate shuttle to Bang Tao Beach. It sleeps 14: the most bedrooms on this list.
items.description: Entire villa in Choeng Thale: 6 bedrooms (1 king, 4 queen, 1 with 2 single beds), 7 beds, 5 baths, on 3 floors. A private pool and hot tub, a full open kitchen, a washer, air conditioning, wifi and free parking. The two top-floor bedrooms connect and share a bathroom. Hosted by 继辉 (7 years hosting; English, Thai, Chinese, Russian and Korean).
items.nearby: The host says: in the Laguna Park 2 estate (gated, with security), a few minutes by the free shuttle to Bang Tao Beach, 8 minutes by car to the Boat Avenue restaurants and shops, with 7-Eleven shops and local markets near the villa.
